ctx.x: Yeah, I knew Charlie real well. I knew him when he first came up and joined Benny. And he was another guy that played by ear. I believe had he learned to read, it probably would have impaired his playing because the guy could play. And, you know, he made a thing with Benny and George Auld called "Good Enough to Keep" at that time, and it was later changed to "Air Mail Special." See? The original name for that thing was "Good Enough to Keep." And I've got an old 78 that they made that on, man, and Charlie…
